about.title: Electric two- and three-wheelers, selected and warrantied
about.intro: LuXana Ride distributes electric scooters and tricycles chosen for their reliability, each backed by clear manufacturer warranty coverage on every essential component — motor, controller, battery, and frame.
about.approach: We deliberately keep our lineup focused on proven models — two scooters, two tricycles — rather than spreading across dozens of references. That lets us guarantee spare-parts stock and responsive after-sales service on every model we sell.
about.warrantyBody: Every vehicle ships with the detailed warranty listed on this page, along with support for routine maintenance and repairs.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data LuXana Ride collects through this site, how it's used, and your rights regarding it.

sections.heading: Data we collect
sections.body: When you use our contact form, we collect the information you voluntarily provide: name, email address, phone number (optional), model of interest, request type, and message. We do not collect any other personal data on this site.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: Information submitted through the form is used only to respond to your request (quote, test ride, general question). It is never sold, rented, or shared with third parties for commercial purposes.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: Messages received are kept for as long as needed to handle your request, then deleted or archived securely.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This site does not use tracking or advertising analytics cookies. No browsing data is collected for profiling purposes.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of the data you've submitted at any time by contacting us directly.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using this site, you agree to the following terms.

sections.heading: Purpose of this site
sections.body: This site presents the LuXana Ride electric scooter and tricycle lineup for informational purposes. It does not support online purchases: any transaction (quote, order, payment) happens directly with our team, by phone, email, or in showroom.

sections.heading: Accuracy of information
sections.body: We work to keep specifications, descriptions, and availability current. This information may still change without notice; final pricing and availability are confirmed when you make a request.

sections.heading: Intellectual property

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: LuXana Ride is not liable for improper use of information published on this site, or for decisions made solely on that basis without direct confirmation from our team.

sections.heading: Governing law
